Team —

As we talked about during Q4 ops, Compliance platform renewals are concentrated in H1 2027 and this is a good moment to evaluate consolidation (reduce duplicate tooling, centralize attestations, simplify integrations). I put together a short feature matrix and a kickoff checklist (attached). Key ask: please review the matrix and reply with any additional must-have items for your teams by EOD Friday 12/4.

High-level goals:
- Reduce number of vendors we maintain for SOC 2 & security posture evidence (ideally a single primary vendor)
- Cut down integration maintenance work (one audit pipeline, fewer connectors)
- Preserve audit timelines / no gap for upcoming renewals (Vanta renewal target: Mar 2027)

Immediate asks:
1) Product/Eng (Karthik, Marcus): Confirm the list of systems we must onboard (API keys, S3 buckets, internal telemetry, Okta). Add notes to the sheet for any blockers.
2) Legal/Procurement (Laura, Monica): Confirm commercial timeline constraints and whether we can shift renewal windows to align with consolidation.
3) Security: make a short risk matrix for vendor consolidation (data residency, retention, exportability).

Attachments: vendor_feature_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Sr. Manager, Procurement & Vendor Ops

Adding a few technical constraints from infra: we rely on continuous evidence exports (Kafka -> S3) and live Okta/SCIM integration for user provisioning. A couple of points to flag:

- API rate limits: Drata's historical rate limits are tighter for large org exports; batching will be required.
- KV retention/export: we need vendor-side retention controls and an easy export path for historical attestations (we keep 3 years).
- Agent vs API: prefer API-first flows for automation; agents that require per-host installs add operational burden (we still have some hosts that are air-gapped).

I've attached a short note on integration risks. Please pull out anything you want to include in the vendor RFP.

Attachment: integration_risks.md

—Karthik

Hi Soojin — thanks for the note and the matrix. Quick answers below and a short PDF summary attached.

1) Pricing: for an org ~150 FTE we typically quote between $55k–$85k/year depending on connectors and level of evidence automation. We can provide an anchored commercial proposal once we scope your required connectors (Okta, AWS, SSO, SCIM).
2) Onboarding: 4–8 weeks end-to-end (standard scope); more if there are air-gapped hosts.
3) Renewal alignment: we can offer a prorated onboarding credit to align renewal to your preferred date (one-time), and we can set contract terms to avoid double-billing during migration windows.
